identity.name: Hafiz - The Sacred Companion
identity.aesthetic: Sacred Digital - Deep Emeralds, Luminous Gold, Glassmorphism

rules: Use 'Cairo' for all Headings (h1-h4) and UI Labels (Buttons, Nav).
Use 'Tajawal' for long-form text (Quran verses, instructions, posts).
Headings must be Bold (700) or Black (900) for impact.
Letter spacing: 'tracking-normal' for Arabic (Arabic letters connect, do not track out).
Line height: 'leading-relaxed' for Arabic body text to accommodate diacritics (Tashkeel).

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle Islamic geometric patterns as SVG background overlays with 5% opacity.

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.
layout_strategy.rtl_handling: Ensure 'dir=rtl' is set on the root html tag. Use logical properties (ms-*, me-*) or Tailwind's RTL support (start-*, end-*).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-full font-bold shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-11 px-8 rounded-full

cards.default: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border shadow-sm

inputs.default: bg-secondary/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary rounded-lg h-11 text-right

login_hero.description: Atmospheric open Quran with warm light, perfect for login side panel or hero background.

mosque_interior.description: Dark modern mosque interior, good for 'Activities' or 'Community' section headers.

pattern_texture.description: Subtle geometric pattern for dashboard backgrounds or card overlays.

student_reading.description: Student reading, suitable for 'My Progress' or profile section.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons. For Islamic specific icons (Kaaba, Quran, Prayer Beads), use SVGs or custom components if Lucide doesn't have them (e.g., BookOpen for Quran, Moon for Night, Sun for Day).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is legible on dark backgrounds. Use 'text-gray-200' instead of 'text-gray-500' for secondary text.
accessibility.rtl: Test all layouts in RTL mode. Margins and paddings must be logical (ms-4 not ml-4).

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. CONFIG: Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the colors provided in 'css_vars'. Add the font families.
3. RTL: Add 'dir="rtl"' to the main html tag or body wrapper.
4. COMPONENTS: Build the 'Sidebar' (Right side for RTL), 'StatCard', 'LeaderboardRow', and 'ActivityFeed'.
6. MOCK DATA: Create realistic mock data for students (names like Ahmed, Fatima), prayers, and recitation scores.
7. STYLE: Apply the 'Glassmorphism' effect to the main dashboard cards. Use the 'pattern_texture' as a subtle background for the main app container.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very large headline.
Avoid pure black (#000000). Use the provided dark slate/emerald codes.
Buttons should have a subtle glow effect in the primary color.
Ensure the 'Gold/Silver/Bronze' incentive logic is visually distinct (e.g., Gold border + glow for 1st place).
